definition: The assurance mode in which the system keeps only evidence recorded after the act; nothing stops the act itself.
The discount factor above which truthful claim signalling pays better than a one-shot deviation; below it, a bond must make up the difference.
The kernel's decision to let a proposed change take effect, checked against 100% of the stated rules before the change touches the shared record & its copies.
A glossary entry whose term the text never defines: it prints with no page number, and the term lint reports it.
